newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - El Chico stock boosted.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - El Chico stock boosted.

text.p: El Chico Restaurants Inc was a half point higher in after hours trading Friday after reporting it had received an acquisition offer "at a substantial premium to the market price."
Traders said El Chico's stock, which closed at 7-1/4 after regular hours trading, rose 1/2 to 7-3/4 during an otherwise slow trading session.

Shortly after the U.S. markets closed, El Chico said the acquisition proposal had been rejected by its board of directors, without any disclosure to shareholders, in light of the present business climate in the restaurant industry.

Integrated Packaging Assembly Corp waited until after the close to release the news that it anticipated a second quarter loss of about $6 million, or $0.43 share, stemming from reduced orders and reliance on a limited customer base. The company's stock remained halted, however, after hours.
During regular hours, the Nasdaq surged almost 12 points to an unofficial record close of 1423 as the Dow rallied about 70 points to close at 7782.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume rose 103,400 from 3,500 on Thursday while session two volume surged to 8,754,680 from 361,324 the day before.
